title: Buy the EVOS German alternative instead.
text:
Buy the EVOS German alternative instead.. I just bought (and have been using) both the competing EVOS German-made reusable cloths and also these Trendy Tripper brand Swedish reusable cloths, so I can offer what I hope is a useful comparison.

First of all, congrats to the Europeans: compared to either product reviewed here, our US-made Handiwipes are a joke.

Based on my heavy use over the past couple of days, I have concluded that the EVOS German cloths are FAR superior overall to these Trendy Tripper Swedish cloths:

The EVOS cloths cost only about $8 for 5 cloths.

The Trendy Tripper cloths cost about $17 for 6 cloths.

EVOS are about 14" x 14" in size (and are easily folded if you want something smaller in your hand).

Trendy Tripper are only about 5" x 6".

EVOS absorb far more than TrendyTripper.

EVOS dry out faster than Trendy Tripper.

There is no reason to spend $18 for six of the Trendy Tripper Swedish cloths when you can spend only $8 for five of a much better product.

I hope this helps.
